source: https://www.howieshapes.com.au/board-models (official Webflow board model pages under /all-surfboards/ — excludes accessories, softgoods, and custom order deposits)

brands.name: Howie Shapes
brands.location_label: Mona Vale, New South Wales, Australia
brands.short_description: Hand-crafted surfboards by Luke 'Howie' Howarth, shaped in Mona Vale on Sydney's Northern Beaches.

models.name: Biggie Smalls
models.description: The Biggie Smalls is our classic all-rounder and the board you’ll be reaching for most sessions. If you keep a board in your car or you’re riding to the beach with one under your arm, this should be it. Our most popular model and a favourite amongst our team riders for good reason, the Biggie Smalls will tear up everything from 2 foot Sydney beachies to 4 foot+ Indonesian reef breaks. Simply put, the Biggie Smalls is a must have in your quiver.

models.name: Black Unicorn
models.description: The Black Unicorn model is named after Howie Shapes test pilot and legendary Mentawaiian surfer ‘Kaliang’ (aka @blackpearlsurfphotography). The Black Unicorn is a close relative of the Biggie Smalls with slight tweaks to the outline, rocker and bottom resulting in a board that delivers speed and responsiveness. The Black Unicorn will suit intermediate to advanced surfers and will go best best in 2ft-4ft+ beach breaks and reef breaks.

models.name: Bugg
models.description: Our Bugg model is all about high performance surfing in all types of waves from 2-5ft. This board is a labour of love between Howie and one of Tassie’s most powerful top to bottom surfers Clifton’s beach’s Luke Bugg. The Bugg comes rock ‘n’ roll ready will hard edges, deep concaves and has plenty of curve and personality to destroy any section in front of you. This board is best suited to intermediate to advanced surfer or for anyone who wants to push the limits of their rail to rail surfing.

models.name: DFSB
models.description: Double Flyer Swallow Baby. This is Howie's Shapes high performance fish, designed for carving up waves in the 2 - 4 foot range. This board is fuller in the nose with a parallel back half of the outline that steps into a double flyer which pulls the tail into the rocket swallow tail. The rocker and bottom design work together to cut through any dead section. The Double Flyer Swallow Baby is all about adding speed and flow on the front foot and plenty of response on the back foot.

models.name: F8B11 Grom
models.description: The F8B2 Grom (Flying Eight Ball Two Grom) model is for the grom that wants to drive hard off the bottom and explode off the lip. This board will have you pushing your surfing; sharp in the nose area with a pronounced hip just in front of fins creates less friction and more response. Full rocker deep single double concaves with vee exiting the tail adds speed, power with the added touch of flow to your surfing. The F8B2 Grom is the ultimate weapon for high performance surfing.

models.name: F8B11 Step
models.description: As the name suggests the F8BII STEP caters for bigger, more powerful waves and water movement in mind - this is a board you reach for when the waves are cooking. Sleek in outline with the centre point forward which focus's on paddle power. Narrow in back half of the outline for quicker rail to rail manoeuvrability and stability. Rocker combining with bottom design to maximize speed, flow and control - the F8BII is a no-bullshit step up you can rely on when your local turns it on. Built for waves 4 to 6+ foot.

models.name: Good Times
models.description: Designed to tear up 2-4ft Sydney beach breaks, the Good Times is a small wave high performance board. Similar in design to the Spider Pig but has less volume in the rail and slightly narrower outline allowing more response. Performance-oriented with tweaks to reflect the reality of the waves we’re surfing day to day - think, better surfing in worse waves. Get Howie to shape your Good Times slightly smaller, wider and a touch thicker than your normal board. Let the good times roll.

models.name: Guns'N'Roses
models.description: The gun. Built for big waves when there’s a lot of water moving in the ocean. On days like these you want paddle power, stability and manoeuvrability, a la our Guns N Roses model. Howie designed this board to be able to take off on big waves as well as turn and avoid the lip with power, speed and flow. Sleek in outline more rocker than most lower rail but higher on the deck, once again built for big gnarly waves. This is an investment in the wave of your life. Be sure to talk to Howie about any particular waves you’ve got in mind.

models.name: H-1
models.description: The H1 is Howie’s favourite high performance board in the range. This thing has been built to blast in perfect conditions at either your local break or Indonesian reef. Sharp in the outline with a small tail block. Can ride in standard ripper dimensions or as a step up for when the waves get solid. The H-1 is a board for those truly memorable sessions. Definitely, look to pack one of these on your next boat trip or strike mission down the coast.

models.name: H-Bubble
models.description: This is Howie's first model concept with a concave deck design. The concave deck, coupled with a low rail shape and high deck-line creates extra drive in and out of turns. A simple outline with wide point forward makes it easy to paddle and catch waves combined with the round tail allows smooth effortless surfing in small waves for all abilities. Ride this board 2 to 3 inches shorter, 1/4 to 1/2 wider and 1/8 to 1/4 less in thickness

models.name: H-Bubble Pop
models.description: This is another High performance fish. Full in the nose and wide with 2 x flyers pulling the tail in to a round tail. Small mushy waves need volume and this caters for that in the area through the nose and the performance in the pulled in tail.

models.name: Killer Pigme
models.description: The Killer Pigme is your go-to small wave groveller but will also perform in head-high perfect waves as well. Plenty of foam under the chest for stability, flotation and easy paddling coupled with soft forgiving rails for speed and drive through dead sections. Great summer board, and something worth bringing on every trip. Whether you are 90kg+ looking for a standard short board or under 90kg looking for a small wave performance board the Killer Pigme caters for all abilities. Full rail, full body outline, low even balance rocker throughout with a moderate single concave deepest under front foot giving you an abundance of water flow, speed and response. The Killer Pigme will have you suiting up no matter what the waves are doing.

models.name: King Grom
models.description: Little kids + little waves = big manoeuvres. For living proof, have a scroll through our Instagram. The King Grom model has a tight curved outline for maximum speed and response in small to mid-size waves 1ft-4ft. This board will have groms pushing their surfing and linking sections with increasing maturity. The rails are soft and low-volumed to cut through dead sections with ease paired with a nose to tail rocker that never fails to deliver speed. The bottom design has a deepish single to double concave for maximum velocity. Speed, response and ease of manoeuvrability are the main design features of the King Grom. Every grom with aspirations of turning pro should have this board in their quiver.

models.name: King K
models.description: The King K is our latest high-performance all-rounder. After months of testing from our team riders, with a lot of positive feedback, we felt it was time to let-loose the King K on the general public. Most commonly the feedback we get is that the board feels easy to ride, smooth and responsive. Everything in this board is subtle, from Rocker nose entry (which is mid-to-high), balanced with a mid-to-high tail rocker. Volume is carried through the entire board with a little thicker nose foil to keep the board from catching in and out of turns. The overall outline is smooth and appealing to the eye, with a little more curve in the back half of the board, and a smaller tail block than the other 'All-Rounder'' in our range (the Biggie Smalls). The King K is very well-rounded standard ripper with great all over balance. It fits in our range between the Biggie Smalls and Black Unicorn models.

models.name: Lions Mane
models.description: The Lions Mane is our latest high-performance all-rounder. After months of testing from our team riders, with a lot of positive feedback, we felt it was time to let-loose the Lions Mane on the general public. Most commonly the feedback we get is that the board feels easy to ride, smooth and responsive. Everything in this board is subtle, from Rocker nose entry (which is mid-to-high), balanced with a mid-to-high tail rocker. Volume is carried through the entire board with a little thicker nose foil to keep the board from catching in and out of turns. The overall outline is smooth and appealing to the eye, with a little more curve in the back half of the board, and a smaller tail block than the other 'All-Rounder'' in our range (the Biggie Smalls). The Lions mane is very well-rounded standard ripper with great all over balance. It fits in our range between the Biggie Smalls and Black Unicorn models. Howie suggests ordering the lions Mane 1/16 less than usual shortboard in thickness.

models.name: Little Johnny
models.description: Go from zero-to-hero with our “Little Johnny” model under your feet. The Little Johnny has all the response and speed any little ripper needs to punt for glory or destroy any section. A Sharp outline with a change of direction through the tail allows their little chicken legs to arc effortlessly off the bottom with total response and release; off the top, in the pocket or in the air. The bottom curve is a slight single to double concave with a subtle vee exiting off the tail built for maximum speed. The Little Johnny model makes every grom a winner!

models.name: Pigme Pro
models.description: The Pigme Pro is the model you want to ride when the waves are small and you want a board that goes and doesn’t require too much effort. Perfect for those slower days or when your local boardriders runs in less optimal conditions. Ride 2 inches smaller 1/2 to 3/4 wider and 1/8 thicker than your standard ripper ! Rocker is low to generate speed. Outline sharp yet full in curve with a medium sized tail block. Rail shape sits full in your hand as deck and rail meet higher up the rail giving you more volume. Bottom design is a deep single concave with deep point under front foot for peddle to the metal acceleration through dead sections of the wave.

models.name: Project 8
models.description: The Project 8 is a combination of 2 board designs (Biggie Smalls & Bugg). It is designed for marginal to decent waves in the 0-4ft range, the result is a board that’s both lively and forgiving. Full in outline from nose-to-tail with good balance, the nose and tail are proportional to width and length. The nose rocker has a good amount of lift before coming into a flat section in between the feet with tail exit kick. There’s a fair bit of lift in the tail rocker to make the board lively under your feet for quick reaction in beach breaks. Rail shape is full in your hand and flattish across the deck carrying thickness through nose and tail giving this board bouncy in sloppy beach breaks. Bottom design combines with rocker to create life under your feet. Single concave running in from nose 6 inches back getting deeper under your chest and forming a bubble like sensation from front foot through to back foot with a little double starting in the back 3rd of the board to free the water up to unlock the suction of the single. Then single runs through and out the tail leaving curve on the edge-line to combine speed with manoeuvrability. This board is designed to react in beach breaks combining with speed and flow.

models.name: Spider Pig
models.description: Full in outline with slight bump in tail. Ride 2 inches smaller 1/4 inch wider and 1/16 to 1/8 thicker. Small wave high performance board also caters for Grommets entry level and the Bigger guys that want to ride smaller yet wider and thicker boards for more performance.

models.name: White Rabbit
models.description: This Is the executive model Howie Shapes surfboard that caters for the Friday afternoon group surf or Saturday morning get together. Larger dimensions in the outline for bigger guys that's built for speed. Voluptuous volume for ease of paddling but cleverly hidden, this board will have you keen to up your weekly surfs. Perfect board for an intergenerational surf with your groms or for anyone who prefers a bit more volume. A well balanced, forgiving board with drive and bite.
